reviewer: game_wire_full direct visual production review; independent acceptance pending

face.observation: Copper teardrop wire cage, round dark-eyed smiling brass face. Direct original/master/runtime comparison confirms identity.

silhouette.observation: Raised bead arm and thin nozzle arm with amber droplet; pear body, pale band and curled wire top match the original variant. Full body is inside transparent margins.

emblem.observation: Original continuous spiral emblem is visible at torso/belt. Directly inspected against original; no substitute family emblem.

material.observation: Welding wire copper/brass finish and small molten droplet retained; original pear body is a grade-specific form, not substituted plate armor. No baked text, RA/EL values or claims of grade performance.

thumbnail72.observation: Directly viewed actual 72×108 raster, comparison and 22-asset contact sheet. Ring/cage face, grade silhouette and spiral remain distinguishable; no cropped hands or feet.
